ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. The A1/A2 sound of a clip reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.clip-sound owns it.

rules.default: A clip without a row hears A1 on camera channel 1 and A2 on channel 2 (channel 1 when it has one), on at their recorded level.
rules.use: A new segment (A1) or cover (A2) of the clip takes the sound kept here; once made it keeps its own sound, changeable on its own.
